title.value: Addressing uncertainty when projecting marine species’ distributions under climate change
title.justification: The title is explicitly stated at the beginning of the document and reflects the paper's primary focus on addressing uncertainties in species distribution models (SDMs) for marine environments in the context of climate change.
title.quote: Addressing uncertainty when projecting marine species’ distributions under climate change

analysis.description: This paper discusses the uncertainties related to using species distribution models (SDMs) for projecting the effects of climate change on marine species' distributions. It provides ten guidelines for addressing these uncertainties to ensure that SDM projections are informative for management and conservation decisions.

type.justification: The paper provides theoretical guidelines for researchers on how to address uncertainty in species distribution models rather than presenting new experimental data or empirical analysis.
type.quote: Here we provide ten overarching guidelines that will aid researchers to identify, minimize, and account for uncertainty through the entire model development process... These guidelines focus on correlative models and were developed at an international workshop attended by over 50 researchers and practitioners.

name.justification: The paper extensively discusses the use of species distribution models (SDMs) in predicting marine species' distributions under climate change and addresses related uncertainties.
name.quote: Species distribution models (SDMs) have been widely used to project terrestrial species’ responses to climate change and are increasingly being used for similar objectives in the marine realm.

name.justification: The application of SDMs in the context of marine species and ecosystems is a central theme of the paper, exploring how climate change can affect marine biodiversity.
name.quote: Although our guidelines are broadly applicable across biological realms, we provide particular focus to the challenges and uncertainties associated with projecting the impacts of climate change on marine species and ecosystems.

name.justification: The paper addresses how climate change impacts marine species and how SDMs can be used to project future distributions of these species.
name.quote: To ensure that SDM projections are informative for management and conservation decisions, sources of uncertainty must be considered and properly addressed.

name.justification: SDMs are the central focus of this study, and the paper discusses methodologies and uncertainties related to these models.
